breaking_news.headline: Mixed economic forecast weighs heavy ahead of midterms
breaking_news.summary: There was a mixed Halloween bag of economic news this week. GDP growth is up, but so are prices.  For now at least, interest rates are staying the same.  What does that mean for the midterm elections?

breaking_news.headline: 'Grasping at straws': Judge dismisses Trump suit against Wall Street Journal over Epstein letter
breaking_news.summary: Saying the president was "grasping at straws," a federal judge on Saturday threw out Donald Trump's $10 billion lawsuit against The Wall Street Journal and media mogul Rupert Murdoch over a story reporting on his ties to Jeffrey Epstein.

breaking_news.headline: Two economists studied California's billionaire tax. They reached wildly different conclusions
breaking_news.summary: What happens in California could shape how America taxes the superrich. But will its billionaire tax fill state coffers — or drain them?

breaking_news.headline: When caring for aging family members becomes cost prohibitive
breaking_news.summary: AARP reports family caregivers are spending 60% more than they were five years ago. Journalist Paula Span discusses the rising costs of caregiving and senior living, and the options available to us.

breaking_news.headline: Chicago entrepreneur turns empty downtown office space into vertical gardens
breaking_news.summary: The pandemic changed how and where the world works, leaving behind a lot of empty office space. One entrepreneur is starting to plant the seeds of a partial solution.

breaking_news.headline: Eastern Kentucky welcomes data centers in hopes they make up for coal losses
breaking_news.summary: In Kentucky's former coal country, data centers are a welcome sight as people hope they will bring in money.

breaking_news.headline: A Binance engineer thought he was interviewing for a job. Then the hackers pounced
breaking_news.summary: North Korean hackers pulled off the biggest cyber heist ever by duping a Binance engineer into thinking he was being recruited for a job, the crypto exchange says.

breaking_news.headline: Legendary photographer on getting that perfect election night picture
breaking_news.summary: On election night, photographers will be in position, ready to snap history-making moments. It's something Pulitzer-prize-winner photographer David Hume Kennerly, has done for decades.

breaking_news.headline: Secret police files released in Hungary, 37 years after fall of communism
breaking_news.summary: Critics say the move comes too late, that the files themselves are incomplete, and the move risks sowing division and causing unnecessary anguish.

breaking_news.headline: Delhi air quality worsens ahead of Diwali as firework restrictions enter force
breaking_news.summary: On Wednesday morning, Delhi's air quality index reading stood at 377, in the "very poor" category.

breaking_news.headline: Israel's president begins consultations with parties after election deadlock
breaking_news.summary: Herzog warns politicians that "not every commitment and promise can be fulfilled" if they want to avoid another election.

breaking_news.headline: 'Most difficult days of my life' for keeper Owono
breaking_news.summary: FC Andorra goalkeeper Jesus Owono puts out a statement through his club, expressing his sorrow and pain after Tenerife forward Jesus de Miguel's death.

breaking_news.headline: French blood storage impacted by freezer hacks as theories swirl about culprits
breaking_news.summary: The French Blood Establishment (EFS) said cold rooms storing blood were impacted by hackers.

breaking_news.headline: Ukraine says bodycam video shows deadly Russian double-tap bombing
breaking_news.summary: At least 40 people were killed and another 30 may still be under the rubble after Monday's attack on a Ukrainian village, Kyiv says.

breaking_news.headline: US midterm results a 'victory' for Canadians hopeful of tariff relief
breaking_news.summary: With Canada-US trade talks back on, Tuesday’s midterm Democratic wave puts pressure on the White House to come to a deal.

breaking_news.headline: 'This is a disaster': Angry Republicans blame Trump for midterms defeat
breaking_news.summary: Some Republicans tell the BBC the president's focus on his legacy and indifference to voter concerns cost them.

breaking_news.headline: Drivers may get compensation offers before car finance saga ends
breaking_news.summary: The regulator says it supports lenders offering early compensation offers, as long as they are fair.

breaking_news.headline: Canva announces major job cuts after 'our hardest year yet'
breaking_news.summary: CEO Melanie Perkins says more than 1,000 staff will either lose their jobs or be asked to change roles.

breaking_news.headline: Graduates are managing AI - but are they learning much else?
breaking_news.summary: Graduates are spending more time managing AI, but are they missing out on other work experience?

breaking_news.headline: Binance says fake job interviews used as part of $6.3bn crypto hack
breaking_news.summary: An engineer was contacted through a legitimate job-hunting platform and invited to bogus job interviews with fake company representatives, Binance says.
